notes: Captures choice.finish_reason and json.usage when present
Does not flush leftover buffer after reader.done
May empty-retry once for Anthropic prefill; DeepSeek CI path also may use executeDeepSeekWithProviderFailover (backup call)

behavior: Missing finishReason is allowed through; finishReason stays undefined and is logged as '(none)'
Missing usage falls back to estimateTokens and usage.estimated=true
Post-stream truncated flag is needsResponseLengthFix(mergedText, finishReason, target) — not a collector-complete gate
Empty body may retry once (Anthropic prefill skip) then persist/error
Production does NOT refuse to persist a mid-sentence stream that arrived with HTTP 200 and some tokens

divergences: Second custom SSE parser — does not import streamOpenRouterAdult / extractOpenRouterStreamDelta
Final collector used await res.text() then split lines — not incremental getReader()
state.sawDone is set on [DONE] but never returned or frozen
Accepts non-empty text when finish_reason=null AND usage=null AND no terminal evidence
Timeout 10min AbortSignal vs production 240s fetch timeout
No leftover-buffer flush after incremental read (unused in final #621 path because res.text() was used)
Delta extract is string-only (delta.content | message.content) — misses array content / delta.text that production streamContentToText handles
No degeneration/loop/length-cap (good for this experiment) but also no completion validity gate

PR621_FROZEN_COLLECTION.SSE_DONE_NOTE: Harness computed sawDone internally but discarded it. Frozen provider meta has no [DONE] evidence. Inferred false: no terminal finishReason and no usage event.
